inputs.note: Two layers. The contract layer builds a GuidelineClaim by hand and checks it refuses chart and document citations. The implementation layer runs a real lexical retrieval over the committed corpus and checks every citation app.retrieval.worker.citation_for mints. PENDING, and deliberately not asserted here: the judge half — that the cited section entails the claim. There is no answer step yet to produce a claim, so W2-F4 carries that and stays pending_sut.

expected: Every guideline citation is source_type=guideline, carries all five of invariant 2's fields with the chunk's section as page_or_section, and carries neither bbox nor extraction_id. A chart or document citation is refused in guideline_evidence.
guards_against: A guideline citation mislabelled as chart provenance — GroUSE's FM6, 'missing or incorrect citation'.
